$comment: Innate traits granted at generation (REQ-HUN-009). Legacy traits earned from chronicle events (REQ-LEG-004) use the same schema with origin: 'legacy' and arrive in Phase 8.

traits.name: Quick Study
traits.description: Learns from doing faster than most.

traits.name: Iron Stomach
traits.description: Suffers far less from hunger in the field.

traits.name: Battle-Born
traits.description: Grows more dangerous the longer a fight lasts.

traits.name: Glass Nerves
traits.description: Capable, but rattled by danger. Morale swings hard.

traits.name: Loyal
traits.description: Forms strong bonds with fellow hunters, and fights harder beside them.

traits.name: Born Leader
traits.description: Makes the hunters around them better. Strong Department Head material.
